C0302.title: Real-Time Detection and Defense Algorithm for CC Attacks Based on Information Entropy
C0302.summary: In August 2012, the IEEE conference paper "An Algorithm of Detecting and Defending CC Attack in Real Time" proposed an algorithm for real-time CC attack detection and defense. The paper uses the way CC attacks disrupt the random distribution of web pages, applies information entropy to detect attacks and identify attack sources, and combines HTTP redirection with cookies to block connections.
